summary.headline: Astrology of Disease and Decumbiture
summary.text: Astrological rules for Moon–Saturn and Moon–Mars configurations in Scorpio, predicting recovery, iron injuries, abscesses, bleeding, paralysis, chronic illness, and danger. The opening of a section on decumbitures and diseases explains how the decumbiture horoscope, lunar epoch, house-masters, applications, twelfth-part of the Moon, benefics, and malefics indicate illness, delirium, bodily harm, and possible death.
